title: Native repair Undo preserves scripted personalization and refuses skipped opening seals
steps: Hold setup, write personalized files, then run step 9 with a native CSS repair and whole-moment Undo using the actual host Git script.
Delay or reject the setup checkpoint and inspect native admission.
Complete a skipped opening seal and native moment through the real turn store and Undo planner.
expect: Undo restores only the repair CSS while preserving initial personalized assets and settings.
Native admission waits for the scripted moment; a failed or missing hold sends no repair prompts.
Any skipped opening remains unsealed and cannot authorize whole-turn Undo; setup opening preserves outside receipts then refuses.
fence: awaited setup file checkpoint before native turns and fail-closed seal evidence
